content: Lewetas Imettida Katamata
Lewe zarkketa kaaleththizayti qeese El7ezeerekko, Nawe naa Iyaasokkonne Isra7eele zareta aawatakko shiiqida.
Kanaane biittan diza Seelon isttas, «Nuni de7ana katamatanne nu mehe heenththasohota intte nuus immana mala GODAY kase Muse baggara azazi woththides» gida.
Histtiin GODAY azazida mala Isra7eele asay Lewe qommotas ba laattida xinxxotappe ha katamatanne mehe heenththasohota qanxxi immida.
Koyro saamay Qa7aate zereththatas istta zarkken zarkken kezides. Qeese Aaroone zare gidida Lewetas Yuhudappe, Simoonappenne Biniyaame qommotappe 13 katamati saaman gakkida.
Hankko attida Qa7aate zereththatas Efreemeppe, Daaneppenne Minaases bagga qommotappe 10 katamati saaman gakkida.
Gershoone zereththatas Yisakooreppe, Aaseereppe, Niftaalemeppenne Baasaanen diza Minaases bagga qommotappe 13 katamati saaman gakkida.
Meraare zereththatas istta zarkken zarkken Oroobeeleppe, Gaadeppenne Zaabiloone qommotappe 10 katamati saaman gakkida.
GODAY Muse baggara azazida mala, Isra7eele asay ha katamatanne mehe heenththasohota Lewetas saaman immida.
Yuhudappenne Simoona qommotappe hayssafe kaalli diza katamata saaman gaththida.
Koyro saamay Lewe qommo Qa7aateppe yelettida Aaroone zaretas keziin isttas imettida katamati hayssafe kaallizayta.
Heytikka Yuhuda biittan gezzetizason diza Kebroone geetettiza Qiriyaate-Arba7enne iza yuushon diza mehe heenththasohota isttas immida. (Arba7ey Enaaqe Aawaa.)
Gido attiin he katama yuushon diza mehe heenththasohotanne mooththata Yoofine naa Kaalebes xinxxo histti immida.
Qeese Aaroone zaretas as wodhida asi baqati biidi attiza Kebroonenne, Libina katamata istta mehe heenththasohora issife gaththi immida.
Yetirenne Eshttamo7a,
Holoonenne Dabire,
Ayine, Yuuxa, Beeti-Shemishenne istta mehe heenththasohora issife gaththi immida. Hayti uddufun katamati Yuhuda qommotappenne Simoona qommota xinxxofe gishetti imettidayta.
Biniyaame qommotappe Geba7oone, Geeba,
Anatoote, Almmoone geetettiza oyddu katamatanne istti mehe heemmizasohora issife gaththi immida.
Qeese Aaroone zereththatas mehe heenththasohora issife gaththidi 13 katamata immida.
Hankko attida Lewe naa Qa7aate zaretas Efreeme qommotappe hayssafe kaalli dizayssi saaman gakkides.
Efreeme gezze deren diza as wodhida asi baqati biidi attizaso Seekeemenne Gezeere,
Qibixayme, Beeti-Horoonenne istta mehe heenththasohora issife gaththidi 4 katamata immida.
Daane qommotappe Elteqe, Gabatoone,
Ayaaloone, Geet-Ermoonenne istta mehe heenththasohora issife gaththi 4 katamata immida.
Minaase qommotas baggatappe Ta7inaake, Geet-Ermoone mehe heenththasohotara issife gaththi 2 katamata immida.
Hayti 10 katamati ubbay mehe heenththasohotara issife hankko attida Qa7aate zaretas imettides.

Minaase zareta baggatappe as wodhida asi baqati biidi attiza, Baasaanen diza Golaane katamaa mehe heenththasohora Ba7eshtira mehe heenththasohora, nam7u katamata ubbaa ekkidi, Gershoone zare gidida hara Lewetas immida.
Yisakoore zaretappe Qisoone mehe heenththasohora, Dabiraate mehe heenththasohora,
Yarmuute mehe heenththasohora, En-Gaanime mehe heenththasohora, oyddu katamata ubbaa ekkidi immida.
Aaseere zaretappe Mishaale mehe heenththasohora, Abdoone mehe heenththasohora,
Helqaate mehe heenththasohoranne Erahoobe mehe heenththasohora, oyddu katamata ubbaa ekkidi immida.

Hessaththoka Niftaaleme zaretappe as wodhida asi baqati biidi attiza Galilan diza Qaadeese mehe heenththasohora, Hamooti-Doore mehe heenththasohora, Qarta mehe heenththasohora, 3 katamata ubbaa ekkidi isttas immida.
Gershoone zareta katamatinne istta meheta heenththasohoti ubbay tammanne heedzdza.
Attida Meraare zare gidida Lewetas imettida biittati Zaabiloone zaretappe Yoqina7aame mehe heenththasohora, Qarta mehe heenththasohora,
Diimina mehe heenththasohora, Nahilaale mehe heenththasohora, oyddu katamata ubbaa ekkidi immida.
Oroobeele zaretappe Baxiranne izi mehe heenththasohota, Yahaaxenne izi mehe heenththasohota,
Qidimootenne izi mehe heenththasohota, Mefa7aatenne izi mehe heenththasohota, hayta oyddu katamata ubbaa ekkidi isttas immida.
Qasse Gaade zaretappe as wodhida asi baqati biidi attiza, Gala7aaden diza Eramoote mehe heenththasohora, Mahanayme mehe heenththasohora,
Haseboone mehe heenththasohora, Iyaazeere mehe heenththasohora, hayta oyddu katamata ubbaa ekkidi isttas immida.
Meraarey zare gidida hara Lewetas gishan gakkida katamati ubbay tammanne nam7a.
Isra7eele asay laattida biittan diza Lewetas imettida katamati istta mehe heenththasohora ubbay issi bolla oyddu tammanne osppuna.
He katamata ubbaa yuushon mehe heemmizasohoti deettes. Mehe heemmizasohoy baynda katamay deenna.
Hessaththo ooththidi GODAY istta aawatas immanaas caaqqida biitta ubbaa Isra7eele asaas immides; histtiin istti laattidi heen de7ida.
GODAY istta aawatas caaqqida mala istta yuushon diza ubbatappe istta shempisides. GODAY istta morkketa ubbaa isttas aaththi immida gishshas istta morkketappe issoyka isttara eqettanaas dandaybeenna.
GODAY Isra7eele asaas immana gida lo7o qaala ubbaa polides attiin issoynne sa7an wodhdhi attibeenna.
